framework.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
framework.provenance: Functions, categories, and subcategory outcome statements extracted from the NIST CSF 2.0 Reference Tool export. Implementation Examples and Informative References in that export are not seeded. Rows whose statement begins with [Withdrawn are CSF 1.1 crosswalk notes and are not CSF 2.0 outcomes. A mapping in this catalog is a workspace assessment. It is not NIST certification.

elements.title: GOVERN
elements.statement: The organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy are established, communicated, and monitored

elements.title: Organizational Context
elements.statement: The circumstances - mission, stakeholder expectations, dependencies, and legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements - surrounding the organization's cybersecurity risk management decisions are understood

elements.title: GV.OC-01
elements.statement: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management

elements.title: GV.OC-02
elements.statement: Internal and external stakeholders are understood, and their needs and expectations regarding cybersecurity risk management are understood and considered

elements.title: GV.OC-03
elements.statement: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity - including privacy and civil liberties obligations - are understood and managed

elements.title: GV.OC-04
elements.statement: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated

elements.title: GV.OC-05
elements.statement: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated

elements.title: Risk Management Strategy
elements.statement: The organization's priorities, constraints, risk tolerance and appetite statements, and assumptions are established, communicated, and used to support operational risk decisions

elements.title: GV.RM-01
elements.statement: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

elements.title: GV.RM-02
elements.statement: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained

elements.title: GV.RM-03
elements.statement: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes

elements.title: GV.RM-04
elements.statement: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated

elements.title: GV.RM-05
elements.statement: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties

elements.title: GV.RM-06
elements.statement: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated

elements.title: GV.RM-07
elements.statement: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions

elements.title: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities
elements.statement: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities to foster accountability, performance assessment, and continuous improvement are established and communicated

elements.title: GV.RR-01
elements.statement: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving

elements.title: GV.RR-02
elements.statement: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced

elements.title: GV.RR-03
elements.statement: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies

elements.title: GV.RR-04
elements.statement: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices

elements.title: Policy
elements.statement: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established, communicated, and enforced

elements.title: GV.PO-01
elements.statement: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced

elements.title: GV.PO-02
elements.statement: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission

elements.title: Oversight
elements.statement: Results of organization-wide cybersecurity risk management activities and performance are used to inform, improve, and adjust the risk management strategy

elements.title: GV.OV-01
elements.statement: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction

elements.title: GV.OV-02
elements.statement: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks

elements.title: GV.OV-03
elements.statement: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed

elements.title: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
elements.statement: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, managed, monitored, and improved by organizational stakeholders

elements.title: GV.SC-01
elements.statement: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

elements.title: GV.SC-02
elements.statement: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally

elements.title: GV.SC-03
elements.statement: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes

elements.title: GV.SC-04
elements.statement: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality

elements.title: GV.SC-05
elements.statement: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties

elements.title: GV.SC-06
elements.statement: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships

elements.title: GV.SC-07
elements.statement: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship

elements.title: GV.SC-08
elements.statement: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities

elements.title: GV.SC-09
elements.statement: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programs, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle

elements.title: GV.SC-10
elements.statement: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement

elements.title: IDENTIFY
elements.statement: The organization's current cybersecurity risks are understood

elements.title: Asset Management
elements.statement: Assets (e.g., data, hardware, software, systems, facilities, services, people) that enable the organization to achieve business purposes are identified and managed consistent with their relative importance to organizational objectives and the organization's risk strategy

elements.title: ID.AM-01
elements.statement: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

elements.title: ID.AM-02
elements.statement: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained

elements.title: ID.AM-03
elements.statement: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

elements.title: ID.AM-04
elements.statement: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained

elements.title: ID.AM-05
elements.statement: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission

elements.title: ID.AM-07
elements.statement: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained

elements.title: ID.AM-08
elements.statement: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles

elements.title: Risk Assessment
elements.statement: The cybersecurity risk to the organization, assets, and individuals is understood by the organization

elements.title: ID.RA-01
elements.statement: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

elements.title: ID.RA-02
elements.statement: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

elements.title: ID.RA-03
elements.statement: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded

elements.title: ID.RA-04
elements.statement: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded

elements.title: ID.RA-05
elements.statement: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization

elements.title: ID.RA-06
elements.statement: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated

elements.title: ID.RA-07
elements.statement: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked

elements.title: ID.RA-08
elements.statement: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established

elements.title: ID.RA-09
elements.statement: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use

elements.title: ID.RA-10
elements.statement: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition

elements.title: Improvement
elements.statement: Improvements to organizational cybersecurity risk management processes, procedures and activities are identified across all CSF Functions

elements.title: ID.IM-01
elements.statement: Improvements are identified from evaluations

elements.title: ID.IM-02
elements.statement: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties

elements.title: ID.IM-03
elements.statement: Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes, procedures, and activities

elements.title: ID.IM-04
elements.statement: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved

elements.title: PROTECT
elements.statement: Safeguards to manage the organization's cybersecurity risks are used

elements.title: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
elements.statement: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, services, and hardware and  managed commensurate with the assessed risk of unauthorized access

elements.title: PR.AA-01
elements.statement: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization

elements.title: PR.AA-02
elements.statement: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions

elements.title: PR.AA-03
elements.statement: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated

elements.title: PR.AA-04
elements.statement: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified

elements.title: PR.AA-05
elements.statement: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties

elements.title: PR.AA-06
elements.statement: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk

elements.title: Awareness and Training
elements.statement: The organization's personnel are provided with cybersecurity awareness and training so that they can perform their cybersecurity-related tasks

elements.title: PR.AT-01
elements.statement: Personnel are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

elements.title: PR.AT-02
elements.statement: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

elements.title: Data Security
elements.statement: Data are managed consistent with the organization's risk strategy to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information

elements.title: PR.DS-01
elements.statement: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected

elements.title: PR.DS-02
elements.statement: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected

elements.title: PR.DS-10
elements.statement: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected

elements.title: PR.DS-11
elements.statement: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested

elements.title: Platform Security
elements.statement: The hardware, software (e.g., firmware, operating systems, applications), and services of physical and virtual platforms are managed consistent with the organization's risk strategy to protect their confidentiality, integrity, and availability

elements.title: PR.PS-01
elements.statement: Configuration management practices are established and applied

elements.title: PR.PS-02
elements.statement: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

elements.title: PR.PS-03
elements.statement: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

elements.title: PR.PS-04
elements.statement: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring

elements.title: PR.PS-05
elements.statement: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented

elements.title: PR.PS-06
elements.statement: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle

elements.title: Technology Infrastructure Resilience
elements.statement: Security architectures are managed with the organization's risk strategy to protect asset confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and organizational resilience

elements.title: PR.IR-01
elements.statement: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage

elements.title: PR.IR-02
elements.statement: The organization's technology assets are protected from environmental threats

elements.title: PR.IR-03
elements.statement: Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations

elements.title: PR.IR-04
elements.statement: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained

elements.title: DETECT
elements.statement: Possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises are found and analyzed

elements.title: Continuous Monitoring
elements.statement: Assets are monitored to find anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events

elements.title: DE.CM-01
elements.statement: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

elements.title: DE.CM-02
elements.statement: The physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events

elements.title: DE.CM-03
elements.statement: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events

elements.title: DE.CM-06
elements.statement: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

elements.title: DE.CM-09
elements.statement: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events

elements.title: Adverse Event Analysis
elements.statement: Anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events are analyzed to characterize the events and detect cybersecurity incidents

elements.title: DE.AE-02
elements.statement: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities

elements.title: DE.AE-03
elements.statement: Information is correlated from multiple sources

elements.title: DE.AE-04
elements.statement: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood

elements.title: DE.AE-06
elements.statement: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools

elements.title: DE.AE-07
elements.statement: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis

elements.title: DE.AE-08
elements.statement: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria

elements.title: RESPOND
elements.statement: Actions regarding a detected cybersecurity incident are taken

elements.title: Incident Management
elements.statement: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed

elements.title: RS.MA-01
elements.statement: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared

elements.title: RS.MA-02
elements.statement: Incident reports are triaged and validated

elements.title: RS.MA-03
elements.statement: Incidents are categorized and prioritized

elements.title: RS.MA-04
elements.statement: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed

elements.title: RS.MA-05
elements.statement: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied

elements.title: Incident Analysis
elements.statement: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities

elements.title: RS.AN-03
elements.statement: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident

elements.title: RS.AN-06
elements.statement: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records' integrity and provenance are preserved

elements.title: RS.AN-07
elements.statement: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved

elements.title: RS.AN-08
elements.statement: An incident's magnitude is estimated and validated

elements.title: Incident Response Reporting and Communication
elements.statement: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders as required by laws, regulations, or policies

elements.title: RS.CO-02
elements.statement: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents

elements.title: RS.CO-03
elements.statement: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders

elements.title: Incident Mitigation
elements.statement: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event and mitigate its effects

elements.title: RS.MI-01
elements.statement: Incidents are contained

elements.title: RS.MI-02
elements.statement: Incidents are eradicated

elements.title: RECOVER
elements.statement: Assets and operations affected by a cybersecurity incident are restored

elements.title: Incident Recovery Plan Execution
elements.statement: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents

elements.title: RC.RP-01
elements.statement: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process

elements.title: RC.RP-02
elements.statement: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed

elements.title: RC.RP-03
elements.statement: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration

elements.title: RC.RP-04
elements.statement: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms

elements.title: RC.RP-05
elements.statement: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed

elements.title: RC.RP-06
elements.statement: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria, and incident-related documentation is completed

elements.title: Incident Recovery Communication
elements.statement: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties

elements.title: RC.CO-03
elements.statement: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders

elements.title: RC.CO-04
elements.statement: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging
